title: Bellbird Bay Rising
author: Orsen Okonkwo
blurb: Felix Nystrom, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
